name: Hashrate strength + mempool congestion -> demand-backed BTC long (fee-pressure confirm)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the hash-ribbon capitulation/recovery variants: those trade the SUPPLY side of miner economics; this trades the DEMAND side — a full mempool means users are competing to transact, real settlement demand that, when it coincides with a healthy (not contracting) hashrate, marks organic network usage backing price rather than the thin ETF-only rallies): btc_mempool_size rising is congestion = genuine on-chain demand for blockspace (users bidding up fees to get included). Paired with btc_hashrate above a health floor (network secure, miners not capitulating) and positive price momentum, it is a participation-confirmed long. Exit on momentum death or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: mempool spikes can be spam/inscription-driven, not economic demand -> KILL if the congestion signal is dominated by low-value spam floods (no forward power). DISCONFIRMER 2: if a plain momentum long matches the deflated Sharpe, the on-chain confirmers add nothing. DISCONFIRMER 3: mempool is noisy/mean-reverting intraday on a 1d bar -> require the signal lead price after BH-FDR. Net of fees, DSR>=0.95.
catalyst: mempool congestion + healthy hashrate confirming on-chain demand
